about_the_game:
The demon army with thousands of monsters is approaching the kingdom. As the new king, you and your companions must recruit the great viking army to the north to join forces and fend of the immenent attack. On your journey you'll learn more about your mysterious power, and find out about the bigger plot between the gods of hell. 

On your adventures you will enjoy the company of the most intriguing companions and learn what it means to be a leader. And... if you play your cards right maybe even find some romance.

A fun fantasy adventure, filled with humor, drama, epic battles, mystery and lots of sex!

Valhalla: Lilith Rising 3 is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel featuring:

  • Over thousands of static images and over 60 animated scenes

  • Over 5 hours of gameplay

  • New sexy love interests

  • An engaging mystery

  • Original music and SFX

  • Plenty of lewd scenes with various girls

  • Episodes 1 - 6

  • Additional content will be added in future updates.

Save the kingdom from a demon worshiping cult

A grand plot that somehow revolves around you.

Date the girl (or girls) of your dreams

Adventure together with six amazing love interests in an interactive adventure environment where every choice matters in building your relationships - each girl has a unique personality, taste and style.

Build your harem

If you’re up to the ultimate challenge you can try and build a harem with ALL the girls - each with their own personality, likes and dislikes.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game is designed for mature audience, and graphically depicts explicit sexsual acts, violence, gore, tortour and BDSM as part of the story. 
The story is not intended for players being in a dark period in their lives. If you are easily offended, this game is not for you.
